title: Total loan amount in each period
goal: uses a loop to traverse the digital array and accumulate items one by one starting from the initial value 0.
summary: The reading room records the number of books borrowed during each period. Add the numbers together to get the total amount lent for the day.
tasks: complete totalCheckouts(counts). Each item in counts is the number of books borrowed during a period.
iterates through the entire array and returns the sum of all numbers. Returns the number 0 when there is no record.

example.note: The variable of the accumulated result is placed outside the loop. In each round, a box name is appended to the end of the previous result.

hint: If traversing with subscripts, the first round should start from 0 and stop before the subscript reaches counts.length. Set the initial value of the sum to 0.
